summary: Botanic gardens car park bays backing onto rainforest; no homes nearby.

drivers.seclusion: Bays on the east side back onto rainforest. Only gardens buildings nearby (cafe, visitor centre); no dwellings.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed public car park with marked bays and a through road. Bays are fully off the lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy daytime visitor car park; quiet after hours.
drivers.convention: Mapped free public car park for the botanic gardens and planetarium; many cars park there.

flags: Busy by day with visitors and cafe
Mapped gates 18 m and 58 m away have a way round
Slope 6% average across whole outline, 12% max
sun_shade: Bush canopy shades the east side from the morning sun; open to the west.

best_section.where: Eastern bays along the bush edge, north of the cafe
